findings.title: Required sandbox refund remains unobserved
findings.evidence: Supplied records report missing development payment configuration and no dedicated provider refund attempt. Browser walkthroughs explicitly use synthetic provider responses.
findings.impact: The corrections support synthetic application safety, but do not establish complete provider acceptance.
findings.recommendation: Keep the actual sandbox acceptance check pending until the app-created, webhook-funded synthetic commission receives a matching confirmed full refund.

rationale.conclusion: The focused corrections resolve the previously identified application retry hazards. No remaining concrete synthetic application defect was established.
static_inspection: The refund job ID and run number are saved transactionally. Retry rejects pending or in-progress jobs; claims and completion reject duplicate or stale runs.
A persistent reservation is committed before the refund POST. Timeout, unknown response, or lost confirmation preserves it, preventing subsequent POSTs even when canonical status remains PAID.
Only the specifically recognized insufficient-balance refusal clears the reservation. Unresolved outcomes remain pending for reconciliation.
The final tests explicitly cover both deadline orders, approval and revision preceding a flag, interrupted-run recovery, active-request overlap, and lost response followed by stale paid status.
The browser harness mounts the actual painel page tree through synthetic authentication, navigation, and transport adapters.

supplied_execution_evidence.suite: 2 Node tests and 72 Vitest tests passed.
supplied_execution_evidence.browser: Two walkthroughs passed, covering upheld and dismissed decisions, participant reloads, reputation, and authorized downloads.
supplied_execution_evidence.checks: Standalone typecheck and optimized build passed.

reviewer_executed_checks: All 19 final snapshot hashes match final-hashes.json.
Specification and plan hashes match approval.md.
rationale.prior_review_resolution: Local overlap and ambiguous-response replay concerns are corrected. Transition-order coverage and browser integration coverage are materially improved.

limitations: Only restricted read-only packet files were accessed. No network, account, collaboration, or external resource access occurred.
Application tests were not executed during this review; execution results are supplied evidence.
Interrupted-run coverage simulates termination through scheduler cancellation rather than an actual worker crash.
Browser evidence excludes browser sign-in, deployed routing, real Convex transport, and external refunds.
A reservation committed before an interrupted POST can remain pending indefinitely. This preserves safety but requires operator reconciliation if confirmation never arrives.
Provider refusal semantics were not independently verified; synthetic fixtures assume the recognized insufficient-balance response means no refund began.
Hashes establish artifact identity, not that supplied execution logs originated from those exact bytes.
